candidates.reason: Repeatable 2/2 manifest generation from hand-cast instants/sorceries directly supplies casualty 2 and conditional spell recovery.
Efficient recurring 2/2 fodder, but end-step/decayed condition is narrower and does not reinforce spellcasting as directly as Cryptic Pursuit.
Instant draw plus 2/2 decayed body is efficient but its interaction is low-impact and no retained slot is weaker than the repeatable engine swap.
Useful graveyard interaction plus fodder and flashback, but does not replace the higher-ceiling repeatable casualty engine.
Value creature can recur, but commander-specific casualty/spell-copy improvement is less direct than repeatable 2/2 manifests.
Casualty-friendly body and temporary interaction are useful but do not materially improve copied-spell ceiling.
Flexible copied spell has a high ceiling but six mana increases dependence on already-established fodder/mana rather than fixing engine supply.
Strong spell-token engine but five mana and non-immediate payoff compete with existing Talrand/Poppet engines.
Powerful token engine but five mana; Cryptic Pursuit comes down earlier and every manifest is exactly casualty-eligible regardless of spell mana value.
Copyable finisher overlaps Torment of Hailfire/Crackle with Power and adds no fodder engine.

red_team_findings.claim: Cryptic Pursuit costs four and produces no body until a later instant/sorcery is cast from hand.
red_team_findings.resolution: The swap intentionally trades Talrand's Invocation's immediate two Drakes for a repeatable engine; the list retains numerous immediate/recurring fodder sources.

red_team_findings.claim: A manifested card is not guaranteed to be an instant or sorcery, so Cryptic Pursuit's recovery trigger is conditional.
red_team_findings.resolution: The guaranteed value being evaluated is a 2/2 manifest per qualifying hand-cast spell; spell recovery is upside, not assumed baseline value.

red_team_findings.claim: Casualty copies or other spell copies could be mistakenly counted as additional Cryptic Pursuit triggers.
red_team_findings.resolution: Copies are not cast; Pursuit triggers only on instant/sorcery spells cast from hand. Evidence explicitly uses that bounded interpretation.

red_team_findings.claim: Premium tutors, copy spells and finishers could function without Anhelo.
red_team_findings.resolution: The token/fodder package and first-spell-per-turn sequencing are retained specifically to fund casualty 2; Anhelo materially increases conversion of those spells.

red_team_findings.claim: Cutting Talrand's Invocation removes two immediate 2/2 flyers.
red_team_findings.resolution: Cryptic Pursuit can generate repeated 2/2 bodies and the list retains Talrand, Baral/Kari Zev, Judith, Lagomos, Poppet Stitcher, Army, Black Market Connections and Ghoulish Procession.

commander_necessity.thesis: Anhelo converts the first instant or sorcery cast each turn into a casualty-2 copy opportunity, making expendable power-2 creatures a spell-copy resource rather than generic token value.

evidence_dimensions.name: commander_identity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Cryptic Pursuit turns hand-cast spells into exact power-2 casualty bodies.

evidence_dimensions.name: engine
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Spell casting, expendable creatures and copy payoffs form a coherent Anhelo loop.

evidence_dimensions.name: mana
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Swap is four mana for four mana; mana base/ramp unchanged.

evidence_dimensions.name: interaction
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Premium interaction retained; swap does not consume an interaction slot.

evidence_dimensions.name: resilience
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Pursuit is a persistent engine but vulnerable to enchantment removal and graveyard/exile recovery is conditional.

evidence_dimensions.name: conversion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Casualty copies scale high-impact instants/sorceries and finishers while fodder engines sustain the resource.

evidence_dimensions.name: combo_integrity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No infinite claim required; manifest/casualty/copy rules are explicitly bounded.

evidence_dimensions.name: card_quality
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Ten relevant alternatives are dispositioned against actual roles.

evidence_dimensions.name: candidate_exhaustion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No unresolved high-impact HOLD remains after current-cycle review.

evidence_dimensions.name: testing
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No unsupported multiplayer win-rate claim; engine swap is justified analytically.

evidence_dimensions.name: rules_confidence
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Casualty 2, manifest 2/2 status, copy-not-cast, and from-hand trigger boundaries are documented.

evidence_dimensions.name: source_freshness
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Current review is anchored to the frozen source and Oct. 13 research evidence.
